markers.description: headword / lexeme (Circassian vernacular in Arabic script)
phonetic form (Circassian transliteration in Latin script)
English gloss / translation (first column main word)
English definition / clarification (parenthetical text in first column)
Turkish gloss (national language translation in third column)
variant form (alternate Circassian forms separated by 'or' or dashes)

rules: Entry boundary: Each table row constitutes a new entry starting with \lx for the Circassian word.
Form matching: The Arabic script Circassian is placed in \lx, followed immediately by its Latin transliteration in \ph.
English tier: The main English word is tagged as \ge, followed by \ps for the part of speech. Any bracketed text (e.g., '(apt, fit)') goes into \de.
Turkish tier: The entire Turkish translation column is captured under \gn.
Variants: Where the Circassian column provides multiple words separated by 'or' or dashes, record the primary in \lx and the alternate in \va.
